original_ai_output.title_zh: 三角洲州APC谴责选举暴力，承诺开展以议题为导向的竞选
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚三角洲州全体进步大会党（APC）竞选委员会媒体委员会警告反对选举暴力，并承诺在2027年大选前聚焦治理与施政表现，而非人身攻击。委员会主席查尔斯·阿尼亚格武周一在州首府阿萨巴举行的媒体吹风会上作出上述表态。此番表态回应了有关前副参议院议长奥维·奥莫-阿格武就所谓选举舞弊发出警告的提问。

key_facts.fact: 三角洲州APC竞选委员会谴责选举暴力并承诺聚焦治理
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The All Progressives Congress Campaign Council Media Committee in Delta State has warned against electoral violence and pledged to focus on governance and performance rather than personal attacks ahead of the 2027 general elections.

key_facts.fact: 委员会主席查尔斯·阿尼亚格武在阿萨巴媒体吹风会上作出表态
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The committee’s chairman, Charles Aniagwu, stated this on Monday during a media briefing in Asaba, the state capital

key_facts.fact: 阿尼亚格武称选举暴力和杀人威胁不属于其竞选策略
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: “Electoral violence and threats to kill people are not part of our campaign strategy,” Aniagwu said

key_facts.fact: 该表态回应了前副参议院议长奥维·奥莫-阿格武就所谓选举舞弊发出的警告
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: in response to a question about a reported warning by former Deputy Senate President Ovie Omo-Agege over alleged election rigging

uncertainties: 奥莫-阿格武的警告内容为据称，尚未证实
事件目前仅有一个来源（Punch）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
